questions: What is the difference between an array and a linked list?

weak_answers.question: What is the difference between an array and a linked list?
weak_answers.user_answer: array stores elements in conitguous side by side memory location while linked list stores elements in scattered memory
weak_answers.expected_answer: An array has fixed size and stores elements in contiguous memory; a linked list consists of nodes with data and references, allowing dynamic size.
